outputs.explanation: Stacked bar chart showing median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin (n=5912 promoters per bin, aggregated); no individual promoter data points are overlaid, only the median summary values are shown.

This is a single-molecule raster/heatmap plot where each row already represents one individual DNA molecule (raw data), not an average; the state-frequency sidebar is a proportion breakdown of this same raw dataset, not a summary statistic requiring overlaid points.
Same representation as (A) for mouse promoters (n=6122): stacked bar chart of median state frequencies per bin with no individual data points shown.
Same representation as (B) for the mouse Skp1 locus: a single-molecule raster showing individual molecules directly, not an averaged summary.

Box plot showing distribution of PIC occupancy across promoter groups; box plots inherently display distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers) and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Box plot showing distribution of Pol II occupancy across promoter groups; exempt as a box plot type that already conveys data spread.
